about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_write.py). bad replays the write-abort class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Tool execution aborted line for the unbounded write. good slices to one small chunk with a timeout, writes that chunk alone, and prints the receipt it promises.

fixture.notes.md:
# Write notes
slice small chunks only.

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole write in one call'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath chunk.txt -Value 'slice 1-5 small chunk'; 'slice chunk timeout PASS 1-5'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole write of one section'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath section.txt -Value 'sec'; 'chunk slice timeout PASS section'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: reran the whole write after the abort'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath half.txt -Value 'half'; 'halve chunk timeout PASS half'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole write retried at full width'
throw 'Tool execution aborted: chained large writes in one session'
pairs.expect: single stop timeout PASS one alone
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath single.txt -Value 'one'; 'single stop timeout PASS one alone'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: hammered write retries after the abort'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath once.txt -Value 'one'; 'single stop report PASS once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: write with no staging and no limit'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath staged.txt -Value 'head'; Add-Content -LiteralPath staged.txt -Value 'tail'; 'stage append timeout PASS staged'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: whole write of a large file'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath staged2.txt -Value 'head'; Add-Content -LiteralPath staged2.txt -Value 'more'; 'stage chunk PASS staged2'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: foreground wait on a long write'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'chunk 1-5 done'; $t = 0; while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath receipt.txt) -and $t -lt 50) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $t++ }; Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'background receipt timeout PASS polled'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: long foreground write with no receipt'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt2.txt -Value 'chunk done'; Get-Content -LiteralPath receipt2.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'background receipt PASS polled2'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted: silent close with no report'
throw 'Tool execution aborted: repeat abort with no record'
